title: Marine reserve at first light
scene_prompt: World Shot. Cinematic documentary photograph of a quiet volcanic-island marine reserve at first light. We see a calm bay framed by black lava shoreline and low mangroves, a small plain wooden patrol boat at anchor with an unmarked hull and a plain canvas canopy, sea birds low over the water, open ocean to the horizon and a gentle volcanic slope behind. Composition: the shoreline, mangroves and boat anchor the lower-right half of the frame; the upper-left half is open dawn sky over calm sea, kept clear and uncluttered as a zone for a headline overlay. Eye-level from a low headland above the bay, immersive, with a sense of scale. Lighting: first golden light grazing the lava rock and the boat's hull, cool slate-blue in the water shadows. Mood: optimistic, a reserve at peace, watched over and protected; end-state, not process. Shot on 35mm lens, f/4 aperture. Kodak Portra 800 film stock. Warm analog color palette, forest green (#0f4c3a) shadows in the mangroves, warm dawn amber (#F4A261) highlights, ocean slate in the water. Fine organic film grain. Natural vignetting. Editorial documentary quality. The image feels like a frame from a film; the viewer is inside the world of environmental protection and feels optimistic about what they see. Full-bleed photograph: no grid lines, no composition guides, no frame border, no rounded corners, no film-edge markings. No typography, no logos, no words, no lettering of any kind on the boat or anywhere else, no identifiable human faces.
palette: Forest green #0f4c3a, warm dawn amber, ocean slate

title: Dark-vessel detection overlay
scene_prompt: PERSPECTIVE: elevated 30-degree downward tactical view over open ocean beside a marine reserve. PHYSICAL LAYER: the dark ocean surface with soft swell texture, a volcanic island coastline along one edge rendered in warm amber tones, vessels as faint amber points. INTELLIGENCE LAYER: the reserve boundary as a dashed glowing teal line; several vessel tracks drawn as clean thin cyan lines; one track ends abruptly near the boundary where its transponder switched off, and further along a radar detection marker appears as an amber diamond with a soft ring, the flagged dark target. HUD PANELS: three floating translucent dark panels with thin cyan borders near the edges: a small track-history sparkline, a compact target classification tile, a radar sweep glyph; all glyphs abstract, no readable text. SUBSTRATE: near-black slate (#0a0f14) with faint contour texture and forest green (#0f4c3a) undertones. LIGHTING: cyan emission from the lines and panels, amber glow only on the flagged element, soft bloom where cyan meets the dark. TEXTURE: halftone dithered grain, subtle scan-line noise on panels, analog warmth over digital subject. Keep the upper-left quadrant quiet for a caption. No typography, no logos, no readable words, no faces.
palette: Forest green #0f4c3a on dark, amber accent on the flagged target
